race.title: J&D Pierce Steeling The Race Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
race.verdict: RED DELTA shaped well when fourth behind Passengerontheship at Sedgefield (boosted form since) on his return and showed his liking for this track when an excellent third in last season's Eider Chase so gets the vote on these revised terms. The latter named rates a big threat though in his hat-trick bid, while Impatient and I Wish You can also play a prominent role in this intriguing handicap. RED DELTA PASSENGERONTHESHIP (IRE) IMPATIENT (FR)
race.bettingForecast: Impatient (11/8), Passengerontheship (9/4), I Wish You (11/2), Ki Woo (15/2), Red Delta (8/1), Pinot Rouge (66/1)
